notes: Big Session replaces Volume King: the badge now rewards a hard, well-spread session kept within your weekly volume limits, not 20+ raw sets of junk volume.
Perfect Week and Unbreakable now reward hitting your weekly session target, not training consecutive days.

Eight new badges: your first weigh-in, logging a tape measurement, a bodyweight squat and a bodyweight row, 25 km of cardio, training every muscle group, 180 minutes of mobility, and taking a recovery week.
Renamed the weekend badge to Weekend Warrior - 'No Days Off' pushed rest as failure.
Big moments now get a full-screen GBA-style badge-get: a level up, a new title, a personal record, or a major badge. Small badges stay as the usual toast.
